pageCache.text:
Headteacher's Welcome
I am delighted to have this opportunity to introduce you to the website of our unique primary school where our goal is to inspire everyone to achieve their very best . Above all else Cranbourne is a happy school. You will find a welcoming atmosphere continuing to permeate school life as we enter our fourth century. At our most recent OFSTED inspection in November 2018, the school received an OUTSTANDING grading in all areas, the inspectors praised the school’s standards which are above average, the quality of teaching is very effective and is strong across the school and also challenges the pupils. Importantly, Ofsted also said that the school is happy and calm with good behaviour and the pupils feel safe.
We provide high standards of learning within a rich and varied school curriculum. Our rural setting enables our children to enjoy learning outside the classroom, whilst our committed staff and active parent community support a range of activities and visits. We value the support of our active Parent Teacher Association, a group of parents who work very hard to raise extra funding for our pupils to enjoy additional opportunities. Although our traditions are never far from the surface an ongoing programme of improvements shows our school looking forward as well as back. I anticipate this website will be a useful source of information for those of you who already know Cranbourne well. For those of you who don't, I hope it will help you begin to scratch the surface of what makes our school special. If you are considering Cranbourne for your child, or to find out more please contact the school office. Kind regards, Mrs. Paula Jenkins Headteacher

PE & Sports Premium Funding
PE & Sports Premium Funding
Sports Funding Overview
Primary PE and Sport Premium is an initiative that aims to help increase and improve the PE and sporting opportunities for children. It was first provided in the 2013/14 academic year.
PE and Sport Premium funding is provided jointly by the Department for Education, the Department for Health and Culture and the Department for Media and Sport. It has been allocated to primary school headteachers and is ring-fenced, meaning that it can only be spent on the provision of PE and sport in schools.
Here are some of the suggested uses of this funding:
As recommend by the Department for Education, we have reflected on the impact of our current provision and reviewed the previous spend. We are required to publish details of how we spent this funding as well as on the impact it has had on pupils’ PE and sport participation and attainment by the end of the summer term or by 31st July at the latest.
To run sports activities with other schools;
To replace or upgrade sporting equipment;
Cranbourne Sports Premium Plan 2025-2026

pageCache.text:
Breakfast / After School Care Club
Breakfast / After School Care Club
The Beehive
Providing Before and After School Care for children aged 4 to 11 years
www.beehiveclub.co.uk
Open daily - Term time only:
Breakfast Club: 7.30am – 8.45am £8.00
After School: 3.15pm – 6.00pm £16.00
Late Half Session: 4pm – 6pm £12.50
Running from Crown Wood Primary School, Bracknell, and Nine Mile Ride Primary School, Finchampstead– see website for more information www.beehiveclub.co.uk
Full day session only: From £45
All Beehive staff are DBS checked, have safeguarding training and hold 12-hour Paediatric First Aid Certificates.
The club manager is qualified to NVQ Level 3 or above in Children’s Learning and Development and/or Playwork.
A Session at the Beehive
The Club’s aim is to continue education through play, while creating a safe, supportive and happy environment.
The club offers a broad range of indoor and outdoor up to date activities, ensuring that children are always stimulated.
Children are encouraged to take an active role within the running of the club, helping with preparing snacks, writing their own rules and choosing activities.
Self-confidence, good social skills and independence will always be encouraged.
The club provides a healthy breakfast and a snack in the afternoons.
Online registration and booking: https://beehive.magicbooking.co.uk
Contact: Office: 01344 203 343
E-mail: enquiries@beehiveclub.co.uk
